name: JHS
author: Tone Zone
description: Pedals inspired by JHS Pedals: hand-painted boxes with hand-drawn art. Screamer and transparent drives, a nine-voice Tiny Tree, channel drives, British crunch, tartan fuzz, a nine-way rat pack, a console preamp, tape and bucket-brigade delays, spring reverb, uni-vibe, chorus, tremolo, dual overdrives and the minimal Trio Series (drives, fuzz, delays, reverbs, modulation, bit crusher and ring mod).
